title: Roasted Chickpea Crisps
description: Seasoned, oven-baked chickpeas that turn crispy — a legume-based alternative to chips.
ingredients: 240 g canned chickpeas, drained and dried
steps: Pat the chickpeas dry, then toss with oil and spices.
Roast at 200C for 30-35 minutes, shaking halfway through.

source.label: Adapted from Minimalist Baker recipe index

notes: Chickpeas provide resistant starch that acts like a prebiotic — a fiber-rich swap for a bag of crisps.
